cim: The Prime Minister participates in an open discussion titled "Armenia’s Opportunities in the Field of Artificial Intelligence: From Vision to Action," held within the framework of DigiTec 2026
cim_eredeti: The Prime Minister participates in an open discussion titled "Armenia’s Opportunities in the Field of Artificial Intelligence: From Vision to Action," held within the framework of DigiTec 2026
szoveg_eredeti:
Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan participated in an open discussion titled "Armenia’s Opportunities in the Field of Artificial Intelligence: From Vision to Action", as part of the DigiTec 2026 event, at the Meridian Expo Center, alongside Rev Lebaredian, Vice President at NVIDIA. Anna Hakobyan, spouse of the Prime Minister of Armenia, was also present at the discussion.

During the discussion, topics were addressed regarding the strategy to transform Armenia into an AI hub, as well as the upcoming steps planned in this direction.

Addressing the establishment of AI plants in Armenia, Nikol Pashinyan noted, in particular, that these companies are also taxpayers, contributing to the state budget of the Republic of Armenia. These funds will be utilized to address the country's needs, such as healthcare insurance, infrastructure development, and more. The Prime Minister observed that the AI sector also fosters the creation of infrastructure, and, according to certain projections, these plants may contribute to the generation of additional jobs.

According to Nikol Pashinyan, while there are challenges in the sector, opportunities are increasingly expanding. "This also depends on the adoption and implementation of policies. Naturally, within the framework of our cooperation, we will keep the needs of our citizens and our people at the forefront, including those who come to Armenia for business. We invite a diverse range of investors to come to Armenia, as, first and foremost, this makes Armenia more visible," the Prime Minister noted, adding that processes related to AI have placed Armenia at the center of global attention.

Nikol Pashinyan also emphasized the importance of developing the AI sector in Armenia within the context of the "Crossroads of Peace" project. "Armenia will now provide international and regional AI services—transmitted via cables and other means. This is a real and tangible infrastructure," the Prime Minister stated. Addressing representatives of the AI sector, the Prime Minister noted that he expects their support in providing knowledge to our society, the Government, and private companies on how to properly utilize artificial intelligence.

Touching upon the development and expansion of AI in Armenia, Nikol Pashinyan emphasized the Government's policy objective and stance: "Our goal is not to replace people with artificial intelligence. Our goal is to use artificial intelligence to make people's work and professional efforts even more effective. And, in our view, this applies first and foremost to public servants."

Nikol Pashinyan also addressed the Government's energy transition strategy, noting that the development of renewable energy has provided Armenia with the opportunity to achieve energy independence: "Currently, we are developing renewable energy, particularly solar energy, at a very good pace. However, we now need to establish storage capacities. It is clear that without them, the efficiency of solar energy is effectively halved."

During the discussion, Nikol Pashinyan also announced that the launch of the TRIPP program will be officially inaugurated in the coming days: "A crucial component of this program concerns energy, specifically, the transit of electricity. We are now set to connect our grid with the electricity networks of Türkiye and Azerbaijan; we are already connected to those of Iran and Georgia. And we are making investments to make energy transmission more efficient. I mean, this is truly a very important and incredible transformation; the 'Crossroads of Peace' project is genuinely becoming a reality."

An exhibition was also organized as part of the event, featuring over 150 companies, 64 startups, and international delegations. DigiTec is the region’s largest technology and artificial intelligence event, organized by the Union of Advanced Technology Enterprises (UATE). In 2026, DigiTec is entirely dedicated to artificial intelligence and is being held under the theme "A New Global AI Hub."
